name: Analysis session
description: Structured document of an analysis call: context, topics, requirements and rules, decisions, open questions.
description_it: Documento strutturato di una call di analisi: contesto, temi, requisiti e regole, decisioni, domande aperte.

sections.title: Context
sections.instruction: One paragraph: the goal of the session, the system, process or problem under analysis and the starting situation described in the call

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: Real names of the people who took part, from the speaker names or from people addressed by name. Never list generic labels such as 'Speaker A' or 'Parlante B': if there are unnamed speakers, end with one item 'Other unnamed speakers'. If no real name appears, write 'Not stated'

sections.title: Topics Discussed
sections.instruction: One bullet per topic: a bold short title followed by 1-3 sentences on what was explained, the positions that emerged and any example given

sections.title: Requirements and Rules
sections.instruction: Requirements, business rules and constraints that emerged. Type is one of: Functional, Non-functional, Business rule, Constraint. Source is who stated it, only if clear from the transcript, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Only design or scope choices on which the participants explicitly agreed. Hypotheses still to verify go in Open Questions

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Doubts, missing information and points to clarify. 'Who answers' only if stated, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Agreed follow-ups. 'Who' and 'By when' only if stated in the call, otherwise 'Not stated'
